openItems: Known wording variant left blocked by design: PR #3578 (marketo, wave05) uses the same checkpoint headings but phrases its sentence '...for the completed committed cli-marketo-parity-wave05-r1 connector parity implementation', ending in 'implementation' rather than 'task', so completedTaskPattern's required \btask\b does not match. Recorded as a follow-up rather than broadened now, to avoid loosening the shared require-linked-issue gate without separate, evidenced justification; the 63-PR non-checkpoint control sweep showed zero verdict changes under the current tight pattern. Widening is deferred to firstmate.

Downstream impact measured, not inferred: building cmd/prissueguard at base 5d61794f7 and at branch head and running both against every open PR body shows 36 of 99 open PRs flip blocked->ok (#3540 airtable, #3543 aws-cloudtrail, and the contiguous #3544-#3577 wave range) with 63 unchanged. An earlier claim that this PR unblocks four PRs (#3540, #3543, #3542, #3676) was an unverified inference: #3541 amazon-sqs and #3542 ashby were never blocked for this reason and already passed at base via explicit Refs #3134 / Refs #3207, and #3676 nativeset carries no issue-reference keyword at all so it stays blocked at both base and head and needs its own PR-body fix.
